name: Volumetric Light Scattering via Froxel Clustering
aliases: scatter local lights in the volumetric fog volume
definition: A rendering technique that computes volumetric light scattering for local lights (point and spot) within a fog volume by evaluating light contributions at froxel midpoints using clustered light lists, skipping the sun and non-volumetric lights.
summary: Volumetric Light Scattering via Froxel Clustering is a real-time technique that computes light scattering in participating media by clustering local lights per froxel to optimize integral evaluation.
